stories.title: Cleveland councilman pushes tougher penalties for street takeovers

stories.title: Cleveland Browns erase 3-score lead, storm back for 27-24 win over Houston Texans
stories.summary: The Cleveland Browns got back to winning ways with more come-from-behind heroics, storming back to beat the Houston Texans 27-24.

stories.title: Passenger dies after being ejected in single-car Carroll County crash
stories.summary: Benjamin A. Dickinson, 22, was pronounced dead at the scene of a single-car crash in Carroll County Sunday morning. Troopers say he was ejected from the front seat.

stories.title: 1 hurt after being shot inside North Canton home; no charges filed so far, police say
stories.summary: Police say no charges are being filed at this time, but the case will be referred to a grand jury for further review.

stories.title: Former Butler mayor Wesley Dingus pleads guilty to reduced charges in voyeurism case involving teen
stories.summary: Dingus pleaded guilty to reduced misdemeanor charges after allegations of being caught on video sniffing a teen's underwear. He received a year of probation.

stories.title: I-90 closures impacting downtown Cleveland traffic this weekend: What drivers need to know
stories.summary: Travelers in downtown Cleveland face major weekend disruptions as I-90 closes for bridge demolitions, beginning Nov. 13. Expect detours and plan ahead.

stories.title: Fire at historic Rockefeller Building in downtown Cleveland was caused by demolition, asbestos abatement work, firefighters say
stories.summary: The fire at the historic Rockefeller Building was deemed accidental, with officials saying it was caused by workers doing demolition and asbestos abatement.
